newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crudes keep falling with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crudes keep falling with NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. West Coast crude values fell Monday in line with a sell-off in crude futures and upcoming outages at local refineries, traders said.
West Coast buyers of Alaska North Slope (ANS) were sidelined to assess the 90-cent drop in NYMEX February crude.
However, a key producer of ANS has stepped out of the market as his company tries to determine the cause of an oil sheen discovered in Alaska's Port of Valdez Friday.
